After the attacks, the target zone explodes, dealing massive Damage to all Enemy Units inside and erasing the Obscurus status. You then return to your starting point.

zh.name: 火盾护身
zh.desc:
施放以自己为中心的环形火墙，火墙会对所有进入的敌方单位造成伤害。
*巫师单位处于火墙内时，将持续为火墙充能；且单位数量越多，充能越快，最多充能3次。
*充能成功后1只火龙诞生，冲向最远的敌方单位，并对沿途所有的敌方单位造成伤害。
*每充能成功1次，都将额外诞生1只火龙。
*位于火墙内的巫师单位获得免伤效果。
zh.quote: 施放以自己为中心的环形火墙，火墙会对所有进入的敌方单位造成伤害。

en.name: Protego Diabolica
en.desc:
Casts a ring of fire around you, dealing damage to all enemy units that enter.
*Duellist units and future selves within the fire ring will charge it up. The more units there are, the faster it charges, up to a maximum of three charges.
*After completing a charge, a Fire Dragon will spawn and race towards the furthest opponent unit, dealing damage to all opponents in its path.
*Each charge spawns an extra Fire Dragon.
*Duellist units receive less damage within the wall of fire.
en.quote: Casts a ring of fire around you, dealing damage to all enemy units that enter.

zh.name: 变形咒
zh.desc:
施放变形咒，被命中单位在变形咒持续期间，所受伤害会增加；受到伤害后，变形效果解除。
*变形咒命中敌方单位后，会在附近单位间随机弹射，最多弹射3次。
*被命中的敌方非玩家单位被变形后，将无法进行攻击，持续3.5秒。
*敌方玩家单位被命中后不会变形，但移动速度降低50%，且控制时间减少40%。
*单位变形期间受到玩家单位的普攻时，不受增伤效果影响，且不会因此解除变形。
zh.quote: 施放变形咒，被命中单位在变形咒持续期间，所受伤害会增加；受到伤害后，变形效果解除。
zh.stats: 弹射次数 3；目标 air&ground；变形伤害倍率 3；伤害增加上限 36→256；控制时间 3.5；减速幅度 -50%

en.name: Transfiguration
en.desc:
Casts the Transfiguration Spell. While shapeshifted, enemies take more Damage. The transformation effect ends after taking Damage.
*When the Transfiguration Spell hits an enemy unit, it bounces up to three times between nearby enemy units.
*When hit, non-player units will be transfigured, and cannot attack for 3.5 seconds.
*When hit, player units will not be transfigured, instead, they will be slowed by 50% and effect duration is reduced by 40%.
*Player Basic Attacks on Transfigured units neither deal additional damage nor remove the effect.
en.quote: Casts the Transfiguration Spell. While shapeshifted, enemies take more Damage. The transformation effect ends after taking Damage.
en.stats: Bounces 3; Target air&ground; Transfiguration Damage Rate 3; Damage Bonus Cap 36→256; Control Duration 3.5; Movement -50%

zh.name: 雪球咒

扔出一个向前滚动的雪球，命中敌方单位或达到最大距离后，爆炸并造成范围伤害。当雪球滚动达到一定大小时可命中空中单位。
*爆炸造成的伤害和伤害范围，随雪球滚动距离增加。
*雪球爆炸后生成一个落雪的雪人，持续对范围内敌人进行减速。
zh.quote: 扔出一个向前滚动的雪球，命中敌方单位或达到最大距离后，爆炸并造成范围伤害。当雪球滚动达到一定大小时可命中空中单位。
zh.stats: 伤害 33→235；宽度 10；雪球爆炸范围 6；雪人降雪范围 30→59；持续时间 7.2；目标 ground

en.name: Bewitched Snowballs
en.desc:
Summons a snowball that rolls forward and explodes upon hitting an enemy or after reaching its maximum Range, dealing AoE damage. Snowballs of ample size can hit flying units.
*Damage increases with rolling distance.
*A snowman will appear in the explosion's wake, continuously slowing nearby enemies in range.
en.quote: Summons a snowball that rolls forward and explodes upon hitting an enemy or after reaching its maximum Range, dealing AoE damage. Snowballs of ample size can hit flying units.

zh.name: 清水如泉

持续施法，沿直线向前方喷出共10道水柱，施法期间可以移动。
水柱每次命中同一个单位，伤害都会递增。

持续施法，沿直线向前方喷出共10道水柱，施法期间可以移动。
水柱每次命中同一个单位，伤害都会递增。

zh.name: 嗅嗅

zh.name: 甜点大师

召唤一位甜点制作者，消耗其部分生命值制作“甜点生物”。

*制作出的“甜点生物”随机对应你当前魔咒组合中的1张召唤卡。“甜点生物”的等级将受到该卡和已拥有对应魔咒两者的卡牌等级影响，两者的卡牌等级越高，甜点生物的卡牌等级越高；生命值为对应召唤物的100%，但不会高于甜点制作者在制作成功前剩余的生命。

*“甜点生物”与当前魔咒组合内的召唤卡共享在场召唤物数量上限。
zh.quote: 召唤一位甜点制作者，消耗其部分生命值制作“甜点生物”。

en.name: Dessert Master

The higher their levels, the stronger the Dessert Creature. Its Health equals 100% of the original Summon's, but will not exceed the Dessert Master's remaining Health at the moment of creation.

en.name: Pawn

Summons a Pawn. When the Pawn attacks, it taunts surrounding opponents. It leaves behind two stone blocks upon defeat. The stone blocks will eventually turn into a Queen piece or enhance an existing Queen piece.

zh.name: 雪人飞来

en.name: Accio Snowman

Summons a snowman, who will roll towards you, leaving a snow path in its wake. Friendly units that enter the trail will quickly side to its starting point and receive a Shield.

zh.name: 马形水怪
zh.desc:
召唤马形水怪，马形水怪会向你指定的位置扑击造成范围伤害，随后，马形水怪将返回并围绕你潜行。在你身边潜行时，每当你对敌方单位造成伤害，马形水怪将扑击已受到你实质性伤害（对护盾值的伤害除外）的敌方单位，造成范围伤害。
*每次扑击时，若马形水怪命中敌方巫师单位或击败敌方单位，马形水怪的伤害将提升12%，最多提升3次。
*伤害提升3次后，马形水怪将在每次扑击后立刻返回你身边。若使用的回响或其它卡牌对马形水怪的攻击速度有加成，则马形水怪攻击速度加成的40%将转化为马形水怪的伤害加成。
*马形水怪在每次扑击完成后返回你身边的过程中，获得50%减伤。

en.name: Kelpie
en.desc:
Summons a Kelpie that pounces at the target location, causing AoE damage. It then returns and circles around you. While doing so, when you deal effective damage to opponents (excluding damage to Shields), the Kelpie will pounce on them, dealing AoE Damage.
*Each time the Kelpie pounces and hits an opponent player or defeats an opponent unit, its damage increases by 12%, up to a maximum of 36%.
*After increasing its Damage 3 times, the Kelpie will return to your side after each pounce. If the Kelpie receives an Attack Speed Bonus from Echoes or other Cards, 40% of that Bonus is turned into a Bonus Attack.
*While returning to your side after each pounce, the Kelpie gains 50% damage reduction.
en.quote: Summons a Kelpie that pounces at the target location, causing AoE damage. It then returns and circles around you. While doing so, when you deal effective damage to opponents (excluding damage to Shields), the Kelpie will pounce on them, dealing AoE Damage.

zh.name: 幽灵骑士团
zh.desc:
召唤幽灵骑士团向前方冲刺，对路径上的所有敌方单位造成伤害并标记，之后骑士队长会单独向敌方巫师再次发起攻击并引爆标记。
*当这张卡处于手牌时，玩家每使用1张召唤卡，都会使骑士团的骑士数量增加1，最多可增加3个骑士。
*骑士的数量越多，冲刺伤害和标记爆炸伤害就越高。

en.name: Headless Hunt

The Headless Hunt charges forward upon use, damaging and marking opponents in its path. Afterwards, the leader of the Hunt will attack the opposing witch or wizard, damaging all marked units.
*By using Summon Cards whilst the Headless Hunt is in your hand, you can add up to three extra Hunters.
*The more Hunters in the arena, the more charge and mark damage they deal.
*The Headless Hunt deals full damage to the first opponent hit during the charge. Subsequent opponents in their path receive 25% less damage.
en.quote: The Headless Hunt charges forward upon use, damaging and marking opponents in its path. Afterwards, the leader of the Hunt will attack the opposing witch or wizard, damaging all marked units.

若共舞期间月痴兽被击倒，则舞蹈失败，立刻结束舞蹈。

zh.name: 雪怪

*If defeated before reaching its minimum size, the Yeti will respawn shortly as two minimum-sized Yetis with reduced Health.
en.quote: Summons a Yeti that deals AoE damage upon appearing and continues attacking opponents. Every second attack deals 60% bonus damage.

zh.name: 阿比盖尔·格雷
zh.desc:
巫师可以选择在自身一定范围内或范围外召唤阿比盖尔协助作战。
当在一定范围内召唤阿比盖尔时，阿比盖尔将以人类形态出战；
当在一定范围外召唤阿比盖尔时，阿比盖尔将以狼人形态出战；
*人类形态的阿比盖尔会对敌方单位施放远程攻击，并将周期性释放速速禁锢攻击敌方单位。（释放的速速禁锢等级与阿比盖尔等级相同）
*狼人阿比盖尔被召唤时会出现在巫师身边，移动至目标附近后飞扑向目标点，在落地后造成圆形范围伤害，并标记范围内1名敌方单位，使该单位获得易伤效果；
飞扑结束后，狼人阿比盖尔将会对最近的敌方单位进行连续4次利爪攻击，并造成扇形伤害，攻击结束后，狼人阿比盖尔将作为近战单位对敌方进行攻击。
zh.quote:
巫师可以选择在自身一定范围内或范围外召唤阿比盖尔协助作战。
当在一定范围内召唤阿比盖尔时，阿比盖尔将以人类形态出战；
当在一定范围外召唤阿比盖尔时，阿比盖尔将以狼人形态出战；

en.name: Abigail Grey
en.desc:
Summons Abigail to fight alongside you. Placing Abigail close spawns her in Witch Form, while placing her farther away spawns her in Werewolf Form:
*In Witch Form, Abigail performs basic attacks with her wand and periodically casts Incarcerous at the same level as her Companion Card to bind opponents.
*In Melee Form, Abigail spawns next to the player before moving towards her target. When close enough, she pounces at the target location, dealing AoE damage and marking a nearby unit. Marked units temporarily take additional damage.
She then performs 4 swiping attacks in a cone-shaped area to damage all opponents in front of her before commencing melee basic attacks.
en.quote: Summons Abigail to fight alongside you. Placing Abigail close spawns her in Witch Form, while placing her farther away spawns her in Werewolf Form:

zh.name: 龙守仁
zh.desc:
召唤龙守仁上场，龙守仁会以敌方当前生命值最低的巫师单位为目标，根据积攒的“焰息”释放至多5次的家族秘术，对路径上的所有敌方单位造成伤害，施法期间免疫控制效果。
*当龙守仁处于卡组中时，巫师消耗移动卡或魔力值会为龙守仁积攒“焰息”，使用魔咒时会额外积攒6点“焰息”。
*龙守仁每攻击5次，便会再次使用1次家族秘术。
zh.quote: 召唤龙守仁上场，龙守仁会以敌方当前生命值最低的巫师单位为目标，根据积攒的“焰息”释放至多5次的家族秘术，对路径上的所有敌方单位造成伤害，施法期间免疫控制效果。

en.name: Long Shouren
en.desc:
Summons Long Shouren to your aid. Upon entering the arena, he targets the opposing duellist with the lowest Health and, based on accumulated Flame Points, releases up to 5 instances of Secret Technique attacks, dealing damage to all opponents along the path. He is immune to control effects while performing Secret Technique.
*When Long Shouren is in your deck, spending MP or using Movement Cards will generate Flame Points for him. Playing a Card grants an additional 6 Flame Points.
*After every 5 basic attacks he performs, Long Shouren will trigger an additional Secret Technique attack.
en.quote: Summons Long Shouren to your aid. zh.name: 纽特·斯卡曼德
zh.desc:
召唤纽特·斯卡曼德，其入场时，从玩家携带的牌组中随机召唤2张不同的魔力值消耗为4及以下召唤卡；在场期间，每间隔一段时间消耗自身生命，从玩家携带的牌组中随机召唤1张魔力值消耗为4及以下召唤卡；在场期间，玩家每使用1张召唤卡，再次召唤的间隔缩短1.5秒。
*纽特·斯卡曼德的召唤物具有额外加成，召唤物的移速增加，召唤物受到的伤害将按比例转化为子弹，于纽特·斯卡曼德下次召唤召唤物时反弹给敌方单位。加成强度与硬币数有关：硬币越多，加成越强，召唤间隔越短。
*玩家携带的牌组中魔力值消耗为4及以下召唤卡（含回响所产生的召唤类衍生卡）的种类数量和纽特·斯卡曼德在场的召唤次数都能为纽特·斯卡曼德提供“神奇动物备忘录”，当“神奇动物备忘录”累计达到一定数值时，纽特·斯卡曼德可以获得1枚硬币，最多可以累积3枚硬币。
*如果纽特·斯卡曼德离场时积累了3枚硬币，此后，玩家使用魔力值消耗为4及以下的召唤卡将获得1次额外的反弹伤害的效果，反弹伤害的上限由纽特·斯卡曼德的卡牌等级决定。此反弹伤害对怪物单位造成的伤害增加。
*纽特·斯卡曼德使用的召唤卡等级与纽特·斯卡曼德的等级一致。
zh.quote: 召唤纽特·斯卡曼德，其入场时，从玩家携带的牌组中随机召唤2张不同的魔力值消耗为4及以下召唤卡；在场期间，每间隔一段时间消耗自身生命，从玩家携带的牌组中随机召唤1张魔力值消耗为4及以下召唤卡；在场期间，玩家每使用1张召唤卡，再次召唤的间隔缩短1.5秒。

en.name: Newt Scamander
en.desc:
Summons Newt Scamander. Upon entering the field, he immediately summons 2 different Summons costing 4 MP or less from the player's deck.
While on the field, Newt Scamander periodically consumes his own Health to summon 1 random Summon costing 4 MP or less from the player's deck. Each time the player plays a Summon card, the interval between Newt Scamander's summons is reduced by 1.5 seconds.
*Summons brought forth by Newt Scamander receive additional bonuses. Their Movement Speed is increased, and a portion of the damage they take is converted into projectiles. These projectiles are stored and fired back at opponents during Newt Scamander's next summon.
The strength of these bonuses scales with the number of Coins Newt Scamander holds. More Coins grant stronger bonuses and shorten the interval between his summons.
*The total number of Summon cards costing 4 MP or less in the player's deck (including summon-type derivative cards created by Echo effects), combined with the total number of summons performed while Newt Scamander is on the field, grants Newt more to write in his Magical Creature journal. Once he accumulates enough pages in the journal, Newt Scamander gains 1 Coin. Up to 3 Coins can be accumulated.
*After Newt Scamander leaves the arena with 3 coins accumulated, whenever you play a Summon card costing 4 MP or less, gain 1 additional instance of reflected damage. Max damage reflected is determined by Newt's card level. Reflected damage is increased when applied to summons.
*The level of Newt Scamander's Summon Cards matches his own level.
en.quote:
Summons Newt Scamander. Upon entering the field, he immediately summons 2 different Summons costing 4 MP or less from the player's deck.
While on the field, Newt Scamander periodically consumes his own Health to summon 1 random Summon costing 4 MP or less from the player's deck. Each time the player plays a Summon card, the interval between Newt Scamander's summons is reduced by 1.5 seconds.

zh.name: 多洛雷斯·乌姆里奇
zh.desc:
召唤多洛雷斯·乌姆里奇。入场后，乌姆里奇的生命值将随时间持续衰减，她会盯上距离最近的敌方巫师，强行加入敌方阵营，并向目标不断逼近。
*当乌姆里奇与目标巫师的距离足够近时，她将严密监视该巫师的一举一动。一旦目标企图施法，乌姆里奇便会强制打断施法过程，使其施法失败。
*打断施法后，乌姆里奇还将签发一次"教育令"，对该名巫师造成惩罚性伤害。签发教育令存在短暂冷却时间，冷却期间乌姆里奇仍能持续打断目标单位施法，但不会重复造成伤害。

en.name: Dolores Umbridge
en.desc:
Summon Dolores Umbridge. Upon entering the field, her Health steadily decreases over time. She fixates on the nearest opposing duellist, joins their side, and relentlessly advances towards them.
*When Umbridge is close enough to her target, she closely monitors their movements. If the target attempts to cast a spell, she interrupts it immediately, causing the cast to fail.
*After interrupting a cast, Umbridge issues an Educational Decree, dealing damage to the target duellist. This effect has a short cooldown. During cooldown, she can still interrupt casts but will not deal additional damage.
en.quote: Summon Dolores Umbridge. Upon entering the field, her Health steadily decreases over time. She fixates on the nearest opposing duellist, joins their side, and relentlessly advances towards them.
